title: Break the pressure cycle
story: Mica recovered the pressure log. The Scheduler keeps cycling the pump; install an interlock before the line bursts.
objective: Return 'VENT' for pressure >= 80, else 'PUMP' for moisture < 30, else 'HOLD'. A missing reading must return 'HOLD'.
lesson: Check for missing keys before using them. Put the emergency condition first so pressure always takes priority over irrigation.
hint: Check both keys, then pressure, then moisture. Return HOLD if no action is needed.
